metric: AN-05: strong = share of pixels whose largest RGB channel differs by more than 64 after a 3x3 box blur; mean = mean largest RGB channel difference (0-255); heightDifference = |native - Cordova| px at scale 3, after the points a block ends under the tab bar (`hidden`). Each case passes within its value plus `margin`.

reasons.header blocks (-0): Glyph rasterization of the temperature, the summary and the bar's title and glyphs (WebKit places glyphs on its own subpixel grid); the sky image's filtering.
reasons.charts (-1): The IN-05 chart drawing (ChartScreenshotTests' tolerances): glyph rasterization and image filtering.
reasons.AQI cells and daily cells (hourlyAqi, cu: Glyph rasterization only; the elements are at the captured positions.
reasons.detail tables (detailWeather -3, detailA: Left-aligned table text 1 px (1/3 pt) from the capture: the table is centered on its widest row, and CoreText measures some Korean texts (fallback font Apple SD Gothic Neo) up to 2/3 pt narrower than WebKit, which moves the table's left edge by up to 1/3 pt; the row text's baseline rounds to the pixel below WebKit's. Each such 1 px shift of a text edge counts as strong pixels; no element is missing or moved by more than 1 px.
reasons.attribution (-5, daily -3): The 12 pt link's baseline 1 px apart on the page color; no strong pixels.
reasons.heightDifference 1: WebKit lays the page out on 1/64 pt and rounds each block's pixel edges; the native block ends on the next pixel.
reasons.not compared by pixels: O03 (o03-weather.png) is IN-07's IonicPopupView over a translucent backdrop: its texts and buttons are compared with the capture (WeatherTabTests), the popup's look is IN-07's. The chart scroll ends of manual pages 5, 6, 8 and 9 are IN-05's ChartScreenshotTests at 393x852.
reasons.toolchains: Each case's value is the larger of the measurements with Xcode 27.2 (local, iOS 26.5 simulator) and Xcode 26.6 (CI, macos-26 runner, iOS 26.5 simulator, run of 6478158e), rounded up; the CI renderer rasterizes the fallback Korean and Latin text of the air tables a little differently.

measuredSensitivity: Mutation checks run once and reverted (2026-11-14): the header block's content 1 pt lower (headerTop 65) failed all four header blocks (strong 0.0114-0.0123, tolerance at most 0.0032 with the margin); table rows 1 pt taller (rowExtra 3.516) failed the four detail tables (strong 0.063-0.113, heights 27-37 px).
